prompt.generated_prompt_string: Use the approved adult Asian woman face reference and maintain consistent facial features through a four-location fashion transformation. Urban afternoon: begin at a small cafe table with the adult woman in a light blue floral sleeveless dress and exquisite necklace, resting her chin on her hand and smiling as a breeze moves her hair; she raises a milk-tea cup with a straw to block the lens. Vintage bookstore: as the cup moves away, transition smoothly indoors to a pink-blue sweet-style Lolita-inspired gothic dress with cat-ear headpiece, lace, and ribbons; she turns lightly before bookshelves, closes a book, and blocks the lens again. Rooftop sunset: the book moves away to reveal dusk; she wears a neat open black blazer with a grey camisole underneath and a miniskirt in mature Oneesan-inspired styling, leans against the railing, and lets hair and folder pages flutter across the lens. Night club DJ: falling pages reveal an urban indoor scene; she wears a plaid shirt with knotted hem, white camisole underneath, and denim short skirt, operates equipment behind the DJ booth, and is surrounded by a cheering audience. Connect every transition through object occlusion and action inertia with cinematic handheld motion blur, fresh fashionable color, and precise music beats.
